title: Make the named-root no-sighting refusal name a remedy the host can satisfy when its turns are not measured
outcome: Make the named-root no-sighting refusal name a remedy the host can satisfy when its turns are not measured
acceptance: When a named root has no sighting on the run through the cut, the acceptance-evaluation refusal states the precondition Engram actually checks: an execution observation on that run with the root's workspace, generation and named state.

When the run has no host-measured turn at all (for example, the host does not run gated turns), the refusal says so and does not tell the caller to repeat a checkpointed turn that cannot record a sighting.
A test covers both refusals: a run with a measured but different-generation observation, and a run with no measured observation.
disposal_reason: Superseded by B (w-da8c79e5d5ab), landed as master 0e52e6fd on 2026-10-31. The "no sighting of named root" refusal text this item would change belongs to the sighting mechanism that B's commit-bound eligibility replaces.
